blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 TR13 的目的與範圍：本報告如何定義無菌藥品製造環境監測 (EM) 程序的建立框架，以及其在污染控制策略 (CCS) 中的角色。
blocks.en: Understand the purpose and scope of TR13: how the report defines the framework for establishing an environmental monitoring (EM) program for sterile product manufacturing, and the role EM plays within the contamination control strategy (CCS).

blocks.zh: 掌握 2022 年修訂版的五大重點：QRM 實務化、數據完整性、EM 先決條件、環境確效維持、RMM 快速微生物方法的納入。
blocks.en: Grasp the five key points of the 2022 revision: practical application of QRM, data integrity, EM prerequisites, maintenance of the qualified state of the environment, and the inclusion of rapid microbiological methods (RMM).

blocks.zh: 理解 EM 程序的範圍界定：包含哪些控制要素，以及明確排除的項目（如 Bioburden 監控參照 TR69）。
blocks.en: Understand how the scope of an EM program is defined: which control elements it includes and which items are explicitly excluded (for example, bioburden monitoring, which is addressed in TR69).

blocks.zh: 了解 TR13 與 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 的對齊關係，以及 CCS 在現代法規框架中的核心地位。
blocks.en: Understand how TR13 aligns with EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) and the central position of the CCS in the modern regulatory framework.

blocks.zh: 解讀與應用
blocks.en: Interpretation and Application

blocks.zh: TR13 的核心定位
blocks.en: The Core Positioning of TR13

blocks.zh: TR13 是 PDA 最經典、最廣泛被引用的環境監測指引。自 1990 年首版以來歷經三次改版（2001、2014、2022），是全球無菌製藥產業在建立 EM 程序時的重要參考文件。
blocks.en: TR13 is PDA's most established and most widely cited guidance on environmental monitoring. Since its first edition in 1990 it has been revised three times (2001, 2014, 2022), and it is a key reference for the global sterile manufacturing industry when establishing an EM program.

blocks.zh: 2022 年修訂版特別強調與 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 的對齊，Annex 1 首次要求企業建立書面的 CCS（污染控制策略），而 TR13 明確指出 EM 是 CCS 的重要組成部分。
blocks.en: The 2022 revision places particular emphasis on alignment with EU GMP Annex 1 (2022). Annex 1 requires companies, for the first time, to establish a written CCS (contamination control strategy), and TR13 states clearly that EM is an important component of the CCS.

blocks.zh: 2022 修訂的五大重點
blocks.en: The Five Key Points of the 2022 Revision

blocks.zh: 相較於 2014 版，本次修訂新增或強化的方向：
blocks.en: Compared with the 2014 edition, this revision adds or strengthens the following:

blocks.zh: QRM 實務化：不再只是「應用風險管理」的概念，而是提供 step-by-step 方法
blocks.en: Practical QRM: no longer just the concept of "applying risk management", but a step-by-step method

blocks.zh: 數據完整性：回應 FDA/EMA 近年對 Data Integrity 的高度關注
blocks.en: Data integrity: responds to the strong attention FDA and EMA have given to data integrity in recent years

blocks.zh: EM 先決條件：先確認設施、設備、人員合格，才能啟動 EM
blocks.en: EM prerequisites: facilities, equipment and personnel must first be confirmed as qualified before EM can start

blocks.zh: 環境確效維持：不只做初始 qualification，還要維持 qualified state
blocks.en: Maintaining environmental qualification: not only the initial qualification, but also maintaining the qualified state

blocks.zh: RMM 快速方法：承認快速微生物方法已被法規接受，鼓勵採用
blocks.en: RMM (rapid methods): acknowledges that rapid microbiological methods are accepted by regulators and encourages their adoption

blocks.zh: 比喻：EM 就像工廠的「健康體檢」
blocks.en: Analogy: EM is like a "health check-up" for the plant

blocks.zh: 環境監測就像定期為製造環境做「健康體檢」——量血壓（粒子數）、驗血（微生物採樣）、照 X 光（趨勢分析）。體檢本身不能治病，但能及早發現異常、預防「疾病」（產品污染）。
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring is like a regular "health check-up" for the manufacturing environment: measuring blood pressure (particle counts), running blood tests (microbial sampling), taking X-rays (trend analysis). The check-up itself does not cure anything, but it detects abnormalities early and helps prevent "disease" (product contamination).

blocks.zh: CCS 則是整套「預防醫學計畫」，而 EM 是其中的「定期檢查」環節。
blocks.en: The CCS is the whole "preventive medicine program", and EM is the "periodic examination" part of it.

blocks.zh: Scope 的十大 CCS 聚焦要素
blocks.en: The Ten CCS-Focused Elements of the Scope

blocks.zh: TR13 Section 1.2 列出 EM 程序需展現有效性的十個面向，這些要素構成了整份報告的骨架：
blocks.en: TR13 Section 1.2 lists ten aspects in which an EM program must demonstrate effectiveness; these elements form the backbone of the whole report:

blocks.zh: 設施設計 → Section 4（環境控制基礎）
blocks.en: Facility design → Section 4 (fundamentals of environmental control)

blocks.zh: 消毒程序 → 搭配 TR70 閱讀
blocks.en: Disinfection program → read together with TR70

blocks.zh: 採樣與分析 → Section 5-6（採樣方法）
blocks.en: Sampling and analysis → Sections 5-6 (sampling methods)

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析 → Section 8（數據管理）
blocks.en: Trend analysis → Section 8 (data management)

blocks.zh: 人員訓練 → Section 4（人員行為要求）
blocks.en: Personnel training → Section 4 (personnel behavior requirements)

blocks.zh: 範圍排除：Bioburden 監控
blocks.en: Scope Exclusion: Bioburden Monitoring

blocks.zh: TR13 明確排除原料藥中間體的 bioburden 監控（製藥用水除外）。該主題由 PDA TR69（Bioburden and Biofilm Management）專門處理。在建立 EM 程序時需清楚界定邊界。
blocks.en: TR13 explicitly excludes bioburden monitoring of API intermediates (except for pharmaceutical water). That topic is covered specifically by PDA TR69 (Bioburden and Biofilm Management). When establishing an EM program, the boundary needs to be clearly defined.
